integrity: The primary open article was inspected at the defining density and support, Section 4.1 likelihood and boundary-MLE claim, the consistency proposition, the simulation tables, and both real-data observation lists and likelihood tables. General parameter-dependent-support literature was checked for broader coverage. The boundary limits are analytic, and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path using the published datasets.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the claimed closed-form MLE but does not classify the true global maximizer for every possible sample.
The sample-maximum endpoint estimator may still be consistent even when it is not a likelihood maximizer.
Bayesian and non-likelihood estimators in the source are not reassessed.
title: The bounded p-exponential sample-maximum estimator is not the MLE
